# @amykit/workflow-setup

Onboarding as an amy workflow: amy setup walks a fresh machine through harness, workflow and channels, one ask at a time.

A workflow for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy): a diagram of where work can go, a
decision per state saying where it goes next, and the actions that happen in the world. The
engine drives it without knowing what any of its states mean.

## Calling it

It takes an input, so it is called from a state of another workflow rather than mounted
as a profile. Depend on it from the package that calls it, mark the state `call` in that
workflow's diagram, draw an edge out of it named for each end (`DONE`, `STOPPED`), and bind it:

```ts
import { plugin as setup } from "@amykit/workflow-setup";

calls: { STATE: call(setup, { input: (work) => ({ /* … */ }) }) },
```

Its settings below are set per call site, with `config` on the binding.

## The lifecycle

| State | Kind |
| :-- | :-- |
| `DETECTING` | initial |
| `HARNESS` | waiting |
| `PLUGIN_INSTALLED` | working |
| `PINGED` | working |
| `WORKFLOW` | waiting |
| `CHANNELS` | waiting |
| `CONFIGURING` | waiting |
| `CHECKED` | working |
| `DONE` | terminal |
| `STOPPED` | terminal |

It emits `ask-setting`, `check`, `install`, `pending`, `ping`, `post`, `read-config`, `setup`, `write-ladder`, `write-settings`, `write-setup-profile` and `write-workflow`.

## Configuration

```ts
call(setup, { config: { policy: { askBackoffMs: 30000 } } })
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `policy.askBackoffMs` | `number` | no | `30000` | how long the walk waits between looks at an ask the person has not answered |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.

## Where the reasoning is

    %% first question to a machine that runs, one ask at a time, through the
    %% same conversation port every workflow uses. The bold states wait on the
    %% person; DETECTING, PLUGIN_INSTALLED, PINGED and CHECKED only work. A
    %% record for `amy setup <plugin>` starts at PLUGIN_INSTALLED for that
    %% plugin and joins the walk at CONFIGURING, so it asks no workflow and
    %% no channels. STOPPED ends the walk naming what failed, and the flags
    %% that would answer an ask nobody could.
    classDef attention stroke-width:3px

    [*] --> DETECTING
    DETECTING --> HARNESS
    HARNESS --> PLUGIN_INSTALLED
    PLUGIN_INSTALLED --> PINGED
    PINGED --> WORKFLOW
    WORKFLOW --> CHANNELS
    CHANNELS --> CONFIGURING
    CONFIGURING --> CHECKED
    CHECKED --> DONE
    DONE --> [*]
    STOPPED --> [*]

    PINGED --> CONFIGURING: the record is scoped to one plugin

    DETECTING --> STOPPED: config.yaml does not parse, cannot be read, or the setup profile cannot be written
    HARNESS --> STOPPED: no conversation answers the ask, npm refuses the harness, or the ladder cannot be written
    PLUGIN_INSTALLED --> STOPPED: the plugin cannot be installed, or its setup failed
    PINGED --> STOPPED: a model the ladder names does not answer
    WORKFLOW --> STOPPED: no conversation answers the ask, npm refuses the workflow, or it cannot be written
    CHANNELS --> STOPPED: no conversation answers the ask
    CONFIGURING --> STOPPED: a channel cannot be installed, its schema cannot be read, or its settings cannot be written
    CHECKED --> STOPPED: a check failed
